description.html: Soudal Silirub AQ is an acetic silicone based on polysiloxane, made for building aquariums and terrariums. According to the manufacturer, once fully cured it is not toxic to animals, stays elastic and bonds well to glass, so it is used for gluing glass, repairing seams and sealing.

Black silicone is a common choice for aquariums and terrariums with a black background or dark frame, because the seams are barely noticeable and the glass edges look neat. Algae deposits in the corners are also less visible on black silicone.

Surfaces must be clean, dry and degreased before application, and old silicone fully removed. The silicone is applied with a caulking gun and cures with moisture from the air. Fill the aquarium or terrarium with water and add animals only when the silicone is fully cured, and ventilate the room while working because of the vinegar smell. Wipe off fresh excess immediately; cured silicone can only be removed mechanically, by cutting.
